**Coaching note:**
After Black's check with Qa1+, you only have two legal moves (Kd2 and Kc2). The key is spotting that Kc2 traps Black's queen—your rook on d1 attacks it, and your king controls the escape square on b1. When your opponent gives check, always check if moving the king cuts off their attacker's escape route. This is how seemingly weak moves become devastating!
